sources.snippet: Slither Video Actions This public repository is being built for video and action-conditioned world-model research. It is currently a staging dataset, not a released training set. Prepared gameplay videos, source provenance, and candidate actions will be added incrementally.

sources.snippet: We propose X-WAM, a Unified 4D World Model that unifies real-time robotic action execution and high-fidelity 4D world synthesis (video + 3D reconstruction) in a single framework, addressing the critical limitations of prior unified world models (e.g., UWM) that only model 2D pixel-space and fail to balance action efficiency and world modeling quality.
